modal.info.title: Platform User Rules
modal.info.rule1:
1. Daily Task Completion
Users must complete 2 sets of orders each day for it to count as a valid sign-in day. After a valid sign-in day, users will receive an additional basic salary issued by the platform.
modal.info.rule2:
2. VIP Membership and Commission
Each VIP level enjoys different commission rates and exclusive benefits.
- For example: Upgrading to VIP1 unlocks 5 additional daily tasks, increasing overall earning potential.
modal.info.rule3:
3. Game Distribution and Promotion
The platform distributes promotional games to users through the TFC system. Users can participate in related promotions to support partner merchants and receive task rewards.
modal.info.rule4:
4. Withdrawal Rules
All withdrawal requests require 1 hour of processing time. After processing, funds will be credited and can be withdrawn.
modal.info.rule5:
5. Task Completion Requirements
The system will randomly assign suitable task combinations based on the user’s account balance and will not exceed the account’s capacity.
- All combined tasks must be completed within 24 hours.
- Failure to complete tasks on time may result in:
- Withdrawal delays
- Account suspension
- Financial losses for both users and merchants (partner merchants’ games will also be affected).
modal.info.rule6:
6. Commission Multipliers
Some combined orders may increase commission to 3–50 times the base rate, depending on the system allocation mechanism and the user’s VIP level.

tnc.title: Terms and Conditions
tnc.content:
1. Account Balance Requirements

1.1 Users must maintain a minimum balance of 50 USDT to activate their accounts.

1.2 Upon completing all assigned tasks, users may request withdrawals. However, at least 100 USDT must remain in the account in order to continue daily tasks. Withdrawals will only be reset once funds are successfully credited.

1.3 Users may invite friends to join the STEAM platform as subordinates. For each completed task by an invited user, the referrer will receive a 0.25 USDT referral commission.

2. Account Security

2.1 Users must not share their account passwords with others. The platform is not responsible for any losses arising from password leaks.

2.2 If a user forgets their login or withdrawal password, they must contact online customer support for assistance.

2.3 Users and merchants are bound by a confidentiality agreement to ensure safe and smooth cooperation.

2.4 All tasks are performed by real users to promote and increase exposure for merchant-developed games.

2.5 Once users begin work, they must maintain account credibility and activity in order to continue participating in optimization tasks.

3. Fund Security

3.1 All funds are securely stored within the user’s platform account and may be used for work or withdrawal.

3.2 To prevent losses, all transactions are processed through the TFC system, ensuring users receive sustainable returns.

3.3 If an account balance or withdrawal exceeds the system’s threshold, a 5%–10% overdraft fee must be paid to unlock the high-value withdrawal channel. Once activated, users may withdraw both the overdraft fee and all remaining funds.

3.4 In cases of accidental loss or exceptional circumstances, the platform guarantees full compensation to protect user interests.

3.5 For each deposit exceeding 500 USDT, the platform provides a 20% bonus to encourage user activity and level upgrades.

4. Task Optimization

4.1 Users at different levels are entitled to corresponding commissions and bonuses.

4.2 Membership levels include: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond.

4.3 Upon completion of optimization tasks, both the commission and principal will be automatically returned to the user’s wallet balance.

4.4 Tasks are allocated based on account balance, and commissions are calculated accordingly.

4.5 Once a task is assigned, it cannot be cancelled or skipped and must be completed within the same day to protect merchant branding.

4.6 Task amounts and commissions will scale proportionally with the user’s account balance.

4.7 Each group of users will be randomly assigned a set of combination tasks, which also cannot be cancelled or skipped once distributed.

5. Deposits and Wallet Verification

5.1 Users may restart their accounts at any time. The platform does not limit the frequency of restarts.

5.2 If additional funds are required for combination orders, users must recharge according to the negative balance shown in their accounts.

5.3 Before recharging, users must confirm the merchant’s wallet address through online customer service.

5.4 The platform bears no responsibility for any losses caused by depositing into incorrect wallet addresses.

6. STEAM Online Game Developers

6.1 Merchant orders are refreshed every minute. If task data is not uploaded in time, the system cannot record it. To protect merchant reputation, all tasks must be completed within 24 hours; otherwise, users will lose withdrawal eligibility.

7. Additional Provisions

7.1 If a user forgets their withdrawal password, a deposit of 500 USD must be paid to verify account ownership.

7.2 When a standard member’s account balance exceeds the withdrawal limit for their tier, a platform usage fee is required. This fee is solely for fund security purposes and will be refunded after payment.
